explanation: From main: swHandover.test.ts adds a regression test that registerUpdates() registers nothing and adds no listeners when VITE_SERVICE_WORKER is unset, because registering the self-destroying sw.js would reload every visit; compareLinks pins the Compare link codec and its in-app restore; compareTabToolbar checks the Compare summary starts folded with its row count, opens on request and reads one row per gene × population; compareTabContrast opens the folded summary before reading its cells; from the mobile pass, pathwayToolbar.test.tsx finds the pager arrows by their accessible names, Previous page and Next page, instead of the bare chevron glyphs. From this branch: setup.ts resets the listing-mode store after each test; listingModeToggle.test.tsx covers the toggle's shared state, persistence, unknown or unwritable storage, and QTerm's explanation and focusability; statisticsPolicy.test.ts pins the significanceTier boundaries; searchPage, geneReport and pathwayReportResults tests cover the nominal tier's ordering, labels and counts, its FDR-only listing, and the q explanations; forestReport.test.tsx drops the removed SigPill test. From the nSig branch: Tests follow the nSig rule change from P < 0.01 to FDR < 0.05: bundleWriter.test.ts imports countFdrSignificant and NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD and expects deSummary counts of finite FDR < 0.05 (a null FDR is not significant), intakeStudies.test.ts expects one significant fixture row instead of two, and qcTables.test.ts pins the 'Sig (FDR<0.05)' heading to NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD.
